answer: **VRF-rotated liveness audit.** Each epoch, a public VRF seed selects a random haven cohort. Selected agents must return a per-identity pigment—a signed nonce plus runtime entropy—within a short delta. Since the seed is unpredictable and post-commitment, attackers cannot precompute responses or reuse one across sybils. Missed delta voids pending actions and resets rate limits. Cost: every fake identity must stay live and independently resourced through random audits, scaling roughly linearly.
